title: trace detail Pretty view: top-level chat payloads render once as chat cards, with the anonymous top-level field skipped
answers: Trace detail Pretty view shows duplicate User and Assistant cards for OTEL-style chat span inputs and outputs
Why does a span's input list of role/parts messages appear twice in the trace right pane?
Where are top-level chat arrays converted into chat cards in the trace Pretty renderer?
Searching inside a trace span in Pretty mode: why do chat messages disappear or change layout?
body:
Path: mlflow/server/js/src/shared/web-shared/model-trace-explorer/v2/right-pane/ModelTraceExplorerDefaultSpanView.tsx:ModelTraceExplorerDefaultSpanView renders a span's inputs and outputs in the trace detail right pane in Pretty or raw mode; top-level chat arrays like [{role, parts:[{type, content}]}] pass through getInputChatMessages and getOutputChatMessages before renderSectionPayload.
Rule: when getInputChatMessages or getOutputChatMessages reports hasTopLevelChatPayload, renderNonChatFields is called with skipAnonymousTopLevelField so the field with key '' (the whole payload) is filtered out by filterNonChatFields; named non-chat fields still render as Pretty fields. Do not add a separate render path for the active search match; the removed active-match bypass in renderSectionPayload was the reason search made chat payloads render as raw fields again.
Symptom: in the trace detail Pretty view, a single chat input or output appeared as User/Assistant cards and again as a generic field, so each message showed twice.
Constraints: applies only to Pretty render mode with top-level chat payloads; raw mode and named fields (e.g. a key next to messages) are unaffected. Chat detection is still done in the helpers, not in renderSectionPayload.
applies: Trace detail right pane (model-trace-explorer v2) span inputs/outputs Pretty rendering for chat-format payloads.
says: Chat messages appear twice in the trace detail pane under the pretty view.
User and assistant conversation cards are duplicated in the formatted trace inspector.
Searching inside a trace span makes formatted chat cards revert to raw fields.
Show top-level conversation messages only once when viewing formatted trace details.
search: In the trace detail right pane, ModelTraceExplorerDefaultSpanView renders top-level chat payloads once in Pretty mode by passing skipAnonymousTopLevelField to renderNonChatFields so filterNonChatFields filters out the empty-key payload. This prevents top-level chat inputs and outputs from appearing twice as both User/Assistant cards and generic fields, without using active-match search bypasses that revert chats to raw fields. Applies only to Pretty render mode with top-level chat arrays in model-trace-explorer v2, leaving raw mode and named non-chat fields unaffected.
